_readme: 官网的版本列表。每发一个新版本，把这一条复制一份放到数组最前面，改 version / tag / date / asset / size / notes 即可，页面不用重新写代码。asset 填你在 Release 里上传的 APK 文件名；留空则下载按钮退回该版本的 Release 页面。tag 要与 Release 的 tag 完全一致。可选 lanzou：该版本单独的蓝奏云分享链接，填了会在「网盘备用」里多出一个本版直链。

notes.zh: 新增「主题切换」：跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色三档，含 OLED 纯黑模式
notes.en: New theme switcher — system / light / dark, plus an OLED true-black mode

notes.zh: 下载支持选择音质（批量多选时也能一次指定），下载文件可内嵌歌词与封面
notes.en: Choose audio quality for downloads — even for batch selections — with embedded lyrics and cover art

notes.zh: 修复酷狗歌单导入：超过 2000 首的歌单现在能完整取回全部歌曲
notes.en: Fixed Kugou playlist import so lists with 2000+ tracks are now retrieved in full

notes.zh: 修复歌单里同一首歌重复出现时，批量下载弹窗闪退的问题
notes.en: Fixed a crash in the batch-download dialog when a playlist contains duplicate tracks

notes.zh: 全屏播放页歌单队列按 Material 3 Expressive 重做：封面列表、正在播放胶囊、长按拖动排序
notes.en: The play-queue sheet was rebuilt with Material 3 Expressive: cover thumbnails, a now-playing pill and long-press reordering

notes.zh: 修复设置页打包报错（单个方法超过 64 KB 上限），并重新整理设置项分区
notes.en: Fixed a packaging failure caused by an oversized (64 KB) settings method and reorganised the settings sections

notes.zh: 评论弹窗、下载弹窗与全屏下载权限弹窗的显示问题修复；首页、搜索页、关于页与启动页整体优化
notes.en: Fixed display problems in the comment, download and full-screen download-permission dialogs; general polish across home, search, about and splash

notes.zh: 首页新增「每日推荐」「新歌速递」与标签歌单入口
notes.en: New daily picks, new-release row and tag-playlist entry on the home page

notes.zh: 搜索页新增「猜你想搜」，四平台聚合取词并去重
notes.en: Type-ahead search suggestions aggregated and de-duplicated across four providers

notes.zh: 搜索页与关于页按 Material 3 Expressive 重新实现
notes.en: Search and About screens rebuilt with Material 3 Expressive

notes.zh: 主题种子色支持 12 套预设配色，切换即时生效
notes.en: Twelve seed colours with instant app-wide re-theming

notes.zh: 下载目录自动跟随应用名称生成，不再写死路径
notes.en: Download folder now derives from the app name instead of a hard-coded path

notes.zh: 启动页、首页与播放器细节优化，切换更顺滑
notes.en: Splash, home and player polish for smoother transitions
